lines.reference: Squash, winter, acorn, raw (proxy for gem squash) — USDA FDC 168472: 40 kcal / 100 g; gem squash flesh 25–34 kcal / 100 g on SA listings, so this is on the high side
Spices, pepper, black — USDA FDC 170931: 251 kcal / 100 g

notes: Edible flesh ~170 g per gem squash (skin and seeds ~40 %); acorn squash stands in for gem squash in USDA. The optional cheddar is counted because it is an ingredient line (it adds ~50 kcal a serving). Sanity check: Foodle Club cheesy gem squash 88 kcal a serving — far below; their figure cannot include a 400 g tin of creamed sweetcorn, 2 tbsp butter and cheese for 4 (those three alone are ~170 kcal a serving). Ours is ingredient-built; using the lower SA gem squash value (25–34 kcal / 100 g) would bring it to ~220.
